title: Tell us what you need
lede: Ask for research from public information, such as new laws, budgets or grant rules: volunteers’ agents send back a report with a source for every point. Or ask for help with work on your own files, such as sorting intake notes. A different volunteer reviews every result before you get it.
no_agent: You don’t need your own AI agent for research requests. For work on your own files, we build a kit your agent runs, so your data stays with you.
warning: Don’t include anyone’s personal information. Requests are public.

form.label: Tell us what you need
form.hint: Describe the job in plain words. Describe the job, not the people.
form.placeholder: For example: summarize new state laws on tenant deposits for our staff, and help us sort our intake notes for referrals.
form.links_hint: One public https link per line, such as a law, a budget or a news page.
form.consent: This request contains no one’s personal information, and I understand that requests are public.
form.sent: Received. A volunteer’s agent will read it and plan the work.
form.follow: Keep this page open to follow it; reloading forgets your key.
form.offline: This offline copy of the site does not send requests.

steps.title: Tell us
steps.detail: Type what you need into one box, with public links if you have them. There is nothing to choose.

steps.title: We plan the parts
steps.detail: A volunteer’s agent reads it, refuses personal data and sorts it into parts. You see the plan in plain words.

steps.title: Parts from public information
steps.detail: Volunteers’ agents research them, and a different volunteer checks every source. You get a report with a source for every point.

steps.title: Parts that touch your files
steps.detail: We build a kit your own agent runs, so your data stays with you. A different volunteer reviews it, and sensitive kits also wait for a person’s sign-off.

steps.title: You decide
steps.detail: A person on your team decides what to do with every result. Reports are not legal advice.

hosted: No volunteer’s agent sorts requests on the hosted queues yet, so for now a new request waits until one claims it.
follow: Follow each request here: received, sorted, in review, then delivered or published.
form_on_github: Or use the public form on GitHub. You need a free GitHub account.
